valuation.stetigkeit: The valuation method differs from the last run (consistency, OR 958c).

stocktake.title: Stocktake
stocktake.confirmConsequence: Posting writes a permanent inventory adjustment for each of the {n} counted variances and files the statutory Inventar (Bestandesnachweis, OR 958c). Posted movements are immutable and can only be corrected by a compensating movement.

error.period_locked: The period is locked; valuation cannot post.
error.invalid_qty: Enter a quantity other than zero.
error.stocktake_not_open: This stocktake is no longer open.
error.uncounted_lines: Some lines are not counted yet.
error.valuation_out_of_order: A later valuation already exists; value the latest date instead.
error.not_found: That record could not be found.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.body: Inventory shows on-hand per item and location and flags low stock. Recording a movement is the one way stock changes; there is no direct overwrite. Valuation computes the period-end stock value and shows the entry before anything is posted. The stocktake counts, shows the difference, and posts it only after your review.
